principle: Tabular data is a true table from tablet up and stacked rows on the phone. Record lists that are not tabular (sections with actions, people with decisions) stay rows at every size.

TABLE.MOBILE: stacked rows exactly as the phone authority draws them
TABLE.TABLET: table: header row (column headers), one row per record, status as a pill column, the open affordance as the last column
TABLE.DESKTOP: same table at the full main-column width; row hover tint; the record name is the row's button
TABLE.semantics: <table> with <th scope="col"> (batch queue) or role=table / row / columnheader / cell on grid rows (received files, new-client received files); a visually hidden header names icon-only columns (OPEN)
TABLE.implementation: TABLE presentations render alongside the phone rows and the declaration toggles them (data-table=TABLE): one is display:none at each viewport, so assistive tech reads exactly one

ROWS.all: AioRows / AioRow: lead icon or disc, title + sub, right-hand content, chevron; children (decision bars) open below the row
ROWS.TABLET+: rows stretch with the column; right-hand content keeps its distance from the right edge

TABLE: batch-queue (<table> from tablet up; stacked rows on the phone)

columnHeaders: Headers only name data already shown in the row (no invented fields): batch queue → CLIENT · FILES · LAST ACTIVITY · STATUS · (OPEN)

transformations.MOBILE→TABLET: stacked rows → table with a header row (TABLE) / rows stretch (ROWS)
transformations.TABLET→DESKTOP: table gains the full main-column width beside the sticky side column

composerFollowUp: batch-complete results and the upload file list are candidates for TABLE once their columns are confirmed with the founder (see COMPOSER_PROPAGATION_MANIFEST.md)
